text:
alex: Heads up — noticed a p95 decode latency jump on canary right after today's merge. Repro on staging. Marking as rollout blocker for now.
maya: saw the CI perf job fail too (perf/regression-4). p95 ~ 2.3x baseline.
jieff: uploading a short perf snapshot, flamegraph link: https://internal/fg/1712000000. Looks like more time in attention kernel selector.
ci-bot: [perf-check] regression detected: decode_p95 increased from 82ms -> 190ms on canary (test=perf/regression-4). See job: https://ci/internal/1712.
sara: ran a quick bisect on staging; culprit narrows to commit abc1f4d (merge: selector heuristic for fused-attn). Repro script: 
```
# repro
PYTHONPATH=./python ./scripts/repro_decode.py --model=gpt-medium --seq=128 --batch=1 --runs=200
```
ryan: can confirm local repro with that commit. Heap profile shows KV cache churn and more kernel handoffs per token.
li: stack trace snippet from profiler: 
```
decode_step -> attention_dispatch -> select_kernel(heuristic_v2) -> fallback_path -> gemm_attention
```
alex: is this the heuristic that tries to prefer fused-attn for short sequences? If it's misfiring we could get extra memcpy/shape ops.
maya: exactly. In this run selector picks fused-attn but falls back during runtime causing extra scheduling + memcpy. That path costs ~40-60us per token in our traces.
jeff: quick numbers from flamegraph: attention_select overhead ~18% of decode time (was 3% before). KV hit rate drops ~7% (due to micro-batching change) which amplifies tail cost.
sara: CI bisect log: https://ci/internal/bisect/abc1f4d — lines indicating change: 
```
- prefer_fused_for_shortseq = True
+ prefer_fused_for_shortseq = "dynamic"
```
ryan: short-term mitigation: flip feature flag to force old selector: `FF_PREFER_FUSED=false` and re-rollout canary. That's fastest revert-without-revert.
alex: can ops flip FF and re-run canary? tagging @oncall. This is blocking traffic to prod routes A/B.
ci-bot: scheduled rollback candidate job: https://ci/internal/1712/rollback-ff.
li: proposed fix is narrower: avoid switching to fused path until kv_cache_warmth > 0.9 and batch_length distribution stable. Working on PR #5123 with tests.
maya: +1 to feature-flag flip now. Also let's capture a long-run profile with `--trace-kv` enabled to ensure no other regressions: 
```
./scripts/repro_decode.py --trace-kv --runs=1000
```
jeff: note for postmortem: instrument selector to emit per-request decision tags so we can correlate with KV miss spikes.
alex: assigning to ryan/li for immediate mitigation + PR. Putting this as rollout blocker in #release-tracker.
ryan: on it, will flip FF and watch canary, then merge li's PR if green. ETA 30m.
li: pushing WIP fix to PR 5123 now, link: https://phabricator/r/5123.
alex: thanks. Keep updates here. If FF flip doesn't stabilize, we'll revert the merge.
maya: update — after FF flip canary p95 back to ~88ms. Holding for 10m to be sure. :thumbsup:
